from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from mashumaro import DataClassDictMixin
from mashumaro.helper import field_options
from mashumaro.config import BaseConfig
@dataclass
class C(DataClassDictMixin):
 x: int = field(metadata=field_options(alias='xx'))
 class Config(BaseConfig):
  serialize_by_alias = True
  forbid_extra_keys = True
@dataclass
class P(DataClassDictMixin):
 c: C = field(metadata=field_options(flatten=True, flatten_rename={'x':'renamed'}))
p=P(C(1)); assert P.from_dict(p.to_dict()) == p
